 Key facts: 1B XRP in Ripple Wallets; XRPUSD Demand; After License $1.31
 Less than 1 min read XRPUSD 1 billion XRP released from escrow Oct 1 remains in Ripple wallets as of Oct 27 (two wallets holding 500M each). Another 1 billion (two 500M tranches) matures Nov 1. 
 99Bitcoins 
 XRPUSD spot CFD shows steady long demand: long‑to‑short ~1.02 (near 1‑month avg) and positive funding ~0.0101%, while other spot/futures indicators signal ongoing selling pressure. 
 Invezz 
 XRPUSD traded near $1.31 after a license ruling; price sits well below July 2025 peak. License bolsters RLUSD collateral, not direct benefits for XRPUSD holders. 
 Beincrypto 
 Ripple’s bank charter does not require buying XRP. The charter omits any mandatory XRP purchases, leaving XRPUSD holdings to Ripple’s separate business or treasury choices.
